name: Muhammad Usman
tagline: Senior Mobile App Engineer & Product Builder
bio: I am a Senior Mobile App Engineer who thrives at the intersection of product vision and technical execution. Over the past 5 years, I've delivered 50+ complex applications for diverse clients on Fiverr and Upwork, engineered complex multi-vendor e-commerce solutions (Fulfil Supply Chain, YouShopper) in Southeast Asia and Australia, and built massive-scale consumer streaming platforms. Beyond building apps, I build the tools that empower other developers, authoring and maintaining critical Firebase Cloud Messaging and Admin SDK packages for the Flutter ecosystem. I dedicate my free time to teaching software engineering on YouTube, focusing on creating visually stunning, highly performant applications that solve real-world problems and drive measurable business impact.
philosophy: Software engineering is more than just writing code; it's about solving real-world friction and scaling impact. Whether saving a project from failure in 21 days or architecting infrastructure for 600,000 users, my approach remains the same: build with resilience, document for the community, and always prioritize the user's end experience.
narrative_tagline: Product-Minded Flutter Engineer shipping scalable apps, rescuing legacy codebases, and building open-source infrastructure.
